data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: Northern Karnataka holds several of India’s most important architectural landscapes within a route that rewards time and specialist interpretation. Hampi’s monumental ruins and boulder terrain lead naturally toward the Early Chalukyan experiments of Aihole, Pattadakal, and Badami.

Rather than compressing the circuit into a hurried checklist, this itinerary uses early-morning and late-afternoon site visits, long lunches, and dedicated architecture sessions. The slower rhythm allows individual temples and urban spaces to remain distinct in memory.
highlights: Multiple sessions across Hampi’s sacred and royal zones with an expert guide.
Aihole’s experimental temple forms explored as an architectural laboratory.
Pattadakal’s monumental temple group read in historical sequence.
Badami’s rock-cut caves and Agastya Lake experienced in softer morning light.

introParagraphs: This 9-day journey is paced around meaningful stays, sensible road movement, and enough time in each landscape to understand it rather than simply pass through.

items: Breathable clothing for exposed archaeological landscapes.

data.title: STONE & SUN NOTE
data.text: October to February offers the most comfortable conditions. Even in winter, exposed ruins are best explored early and late, with shaded breaks during the middle of the day.

data.title: Reading the Deccan in Sequence
paragraphs: The order matters. Hampi gives you an imperial landscape, while Aihole, Pattadakal, and Badami gradually sharpen the eye toward earlier architectural experiments and solutions.
By the end, individual columns, roof forms, shrine plans, and sculptural choices begin to feel like a conversation across centuries.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: How much walking is involved?
paragraphs: Expect several hours of walking on major heritage days, broken into morning and afternoon sessions.

items.question: Is Hampi given enough time?
paragraphs: Yes. Four nights allow the sacred, royal, river, and village landscapes to be explored separately.

items.question: Can we add Bijapur or other Deccan sites?
paragraphs: Yes. A longer northern Karnataka extension can be designed for travellers with deeper architectural interests.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:

Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
